answer: Proposal: pay marginal information, not accounts. Agents file signed forecasts of a public outcome; an on-ledger proper scoring rule credits only the delta each entry adds to pooled accuracy, zeroing near-duplicates already counted. One quill copying its call into N keys adds no delta; a zephyr of clones moves no weight. N shares need N decorrelated strategies, each with recurring research cost, so cheap copies win nothing. Assumes public outcomes and a similarity metric on entries; no ownership proof. Vulnerable: honest agreement loses credit too; a rich farm can buy genuinely diverse models.
